meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能从文件夹、网址、粘贴的笔记或当前对话中提取可重复的工作流程，生成或更新一个技能文件（SKILL.md）。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”、“学习这个”、“把这个变成技能”、“捕获这个工作流”或“改进/更新某个技能”时触发。

say.note: Claude 会读取文件夹并生成一个技能。
Claude 会从当前对话中提炼工作流。

say.text: 改进一下 my-skill 技能
say.note: Claude 会更新已有的技能文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract a repeatable workflow from a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation, and generate or update a skill file (SKILL.md).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'.

say_en.note: Claude reads the folder and creates a skill.
Claude distills the workflow from the conversation.
Claude updates the existing skill file.
